text: Screen header ('Receipts' title): Title is rendered at display size, flush to the top edge (clipped on phone) and flush to the left gutter; no safe-area inset and it doesn't match Material 3 top-app-bar hierarchy. Expected after the fix: Create src/components/ui/ScreenHeader.tsx used by every screen: a View with paddingTop = useSafeAreaInsets().top + 16, paddingHorizontal 16, paddingBottom 16, containing <Text variant="headlineMedium" style={{color: theme.colors.onSurface}}>. Remove per-screen title styles.

Receipt card content (amount / Date: / Category: / note): Four stacked label-prefixed body lines of equal weight; 'Date:' and 'Category:' labels waste space and there is no visual hierarchy or alignment with the amount. Expected after the fix: Build shared src/components/ui/TransactionRow.tsx rendering a Card.Content with a row: left column = <Text variant="titleMedium"> amount, <Text variant="bodyMedium" color onSurfaceVariant> note (e.g. 'Office supplies'), and <Text variant="bodySmall" onSurfaceVariant>'11 Nov 2026 · Supplies' (drop the 'Date:'/'Category:' labels, format date as D MMM YYYY)

'Expense' label, top-right of each card: Plain teal text looks like a tappable link and competes with the amount for attention. Expected after the fix: Replace with <Chip compact mode="flat" textStyle={{fontSize:12}}> using theme.colors.secondaryContainer / onSecondaryContainer, aligned to the top-right of the row.

'[photo attached]' italic bracketed text: Reads as a developer placeholder, not UI; brackets and italics are off-system. Expected after the fix: Replace with a 40x40 rounded (8px radius) Image thumbnail on the leading edge of the row when a photo exists, or if no URI is available an <Icon source="paperclip" size={16} color={onSurfaceVariant}/> next to the date line. Delete the bracketed string.

Primary action (missing FAB): Large empty area below the list and no way to add a receipt from the Receipts tab, violating the 'never stranded' rule in the spec. Expected after the fix: Add <FAB icon="plus" label="Add receipt" onPress={navigate('ReceiptEntry')} style={{position:'absolute', right:16, bottom: tabBarHeight + 16}}/> using theme.colors.primaryContainer, and give the FlatList contentContainerStyle paddingBottom 96 so the last card clears it.

Card surface / elevation: Cards use a heavy drop shadow and very large corner radius on a grey background, which looks dated against MD3. Expected after the fix: In theme.ts set roundness: 3 (12px) and use <Card mode="outlined"> as the shared default in TransactionRow: 1px outline theme.colors.outlineVariant, backgroundColor surface, elevation 0.

Desktop layout — content column: At 1280px the cards sit in a ~390px column with the title hugging it, leaving the page looking like a stretched phone screen. Expected after the fix: In the shared screen container, set contentContainerStyle={{width:'100%', maxWidth:720, alignSelf:'center', paddingHorizontal:24}} so header and cards share one 720px column at desktop width.

Bottom navigation bar: On desktop the four tabs are spread edge-to-edge across 1280px with tiny labels; on phone the bar has no safe-area bottom padding. Expected after the fix: Wrap the BottomNavigation.Bar content in a View with maxWidth 640, alignSelf 'center', width '100%', and add paddingBottom = insets.bottom; keep labels at variant labelMedium with active color theme.colors.primary, inactive onSurfaceVariant.
